I am a proactive learner with hands-on experience in building machine learning models, working with various datasets, and exploring the latest trends in AI.

projects.title: Personal Portfolio
projects.description:
Architecture: Engineered a premium personal portfolio website decoupled from its visual presentation using a central data schema (portfolio.json).
Interactivity: Developed GPU-accelerated UI features including mouse-tracking 3D card tilts, timeline focus overlays, and dynamic brand pop-ups.
Administration: Created a secure, responsive visual Admin Dashboard (CMS) for managing biography details, skills, timeline milestones, and projects.
Backend API: Configured local PowerShell REST endpoints to support secure database updates and binary image uploads to folder assets directly from the browser.
Deployment: Deployed the static codebase live to GitHub Pages with automated builds synced to branch commits.
